title: Atlas runtime policy manifest (Phase-2 G1)
note: Pins the critical runtime switches main.py constructs. Read-only reference: core/policy_manifest.py compares the running application with it and any difference is BLOCK_NEW_RISK. Nothing is ever applied from this file and it can never enable LIVE. Changing a switch means a new versioned manifest (successor record) plus the matching code change, never an in-place edit.
owner_approval_note: No owner ratification of this manifest is recorded. The switch values are the ones main.py already runs with; their own provenance is listed in sources. Ratification is an owner decision.

sources.execution_mode: main.py EXECUTION_MODE; core/atlas_config.py refuses anything but PAPER (live_authority=DENIED)
sources.live_execution_enabled: ExecutionManager default; live_authority=DENIED in the registry authority_state
sources.global_minimum_confidence: core/risk_engine.py RiskPolicy default (0-1 consensus scale; Phase-2 E1: not a probability)
sources.paper_confidence_experiment: main.py call site; EXP-002 switched on by the owner 2026-10-01 (main.py comment) - registry record UNKNOWN
sources.paper_confidence_experiment_id: main.py call site (EXP-001 stopped, registry v5.71)
sources.fusion_full_weight_denominator: not passed by main.py (default off; owner decision pending per fusion dissent design)
sources.order_lifecycle_observe: main.py call site; owner approved 2026-10-01 (observe only)
sources.paper_fill_model: operator choice via ATLAS_FILL_MODEL (Shadow S2, owner approval 2026-10-02); validated by core/atlas_config.py
sources.exit_guard_mode: core/exit_guard.py default; Phase-2 B2 inert - ENFORCE is an owner decision
